verdict.rationale: BigCommerce's own docs say developers can "extend checkout" and list a first-party Checkout SDK (checkout-sdk-js), so a supported extension point exists rather than requiring a fork. Neither mention says which parts of checkout can be customized. missing for 10: documented customization of checkout fields, branding/styling of checkout, discount logic hooks, validation logic extension points, and independent or hands-on corroboration of checkout extensibility.

support.subject: As a developer, I can customize checkout — fields, branding, discounts, and validation logic — through supported extension points rather than forking checkout

citations.quote: Create single-click apps for the BigCommerce marketplace, build custom integrations, or extend checkout.
